cases.prerequisites: Repository root with normal host-tool and modern build dependencies; sanitizer/runtime checks support the selected host compiler, while Build CI requires a successful GCC -fanalyzer compile probe.
cases.actions: Run make codeql-alerts-test, the modernization suite, documentation checker, and modern build gates.
cases.expected_result: Adversarial qualifiers remain bounded by process CPU time, unsafe PNG products are rejected, format checking passes, invalid map/event extents do not mutate state, invalid event-slot queue operands, an empty dequeue, or a 31st queue push fail safely, and six hits plus sentinel fit without overwrite.
cases.negative_control: The fixtures exercise the exact pre-fix ambiguous regex, narrowed products, format mismatch, wrapping indices, unchecked event-slot indexing, queue underflow, and one-past-end sentinel write.
cases.interactions: No dependencies or conflicts with starter features, localization, generated data, item caps, configuration identity, or saves.
cases.save_compatibility: No save field, migration, layout, or compatibility-epoch change.
cases.cleanup: Use make clean_fast for ROM artifacts; host test outputs are ignored under build/tests/codeql.
cases.limitations: GitHub source-alert state updates only after remote analysis; false positives are dismissed in GitHub without source suppression, and supported non-GCC hosts explicitly skip analyzer-only checks after runtime harnesses pass.
